name: Solfège Studio
summary:
Solfège Studio turns the hand signs used in music education into a playable instrument. Make a sign and hear its note.

Play with either hand in Free Play, or both for melody and harmony. All 17 signs are available, including sharps and flats. Move between two height bands to change register, choose from 42 instrument sounds, and play in immersive environments or your own room with passthrough.

Two guided lessons teach The Basic Signs and Sharps and Flats. Diagrams show both hands, and each step waits for
